title: Doozy Vape Co Avalanche E-Liquid 10ml
description: Doozy Vape Co’s Lush Avalanche eliquid gives fruit the frosty treatment thanks to a layer of juicy sweet berries mellowed with a little tropical tang from lychee, and all finished to perfection with a rush of cool menthol on the exhale. The 70% Vegetable Glycerine, 30% Propylene Glycol formula makes this eliquid ideal for sub-ohm vaping, producing mighty clouds on top of fantastic flavour and a smooth, comfortable, throat hit. Sub-ohm vaping generally requires the use of high-powered vape kits, including pod vape kits and pod mods with higher power outputs, some pen vape kits and advanced kits .
